decisions.reason: F2 already delivered the scoped rule/boundary and exact path semantics required by the duplicate; F1 must verify applicability and record reuse rather than reimplement it.

Policy exists, but the current Poise source has no owner that exposes IDE/AST navigation against an explicitly supplied AI-poise checkout with index identity/freshness diagnostics. Implement only that gap; do not bundle an indexer or second IDE owner.

Exact argv/cwd execution, bounded process ownership, capability probing and clear failure paths largely exist. The Task should first demonstrate AI-poise-specific remaining helper gaps and add only those; no external-project runtime policy.
No Markdown formatter fallback is shipped. Add an explicit-file check/fix fallback for AI-poise only, preserving fenced code/front matter/table behavior and IDE-first preference.

The catalog and decomposition metadata exist, but there is no declarative selection-condition metadata for AI-poise shipped skills that a single router consumes. Add selection facts only; do not create ERP profile documents or a universal external-repository schema.

There is no current routing owner deriving scoped rules, skills and registered checks from explicit task/change facts. Implement one deterministic AI-poise routing owner without changing path resolution or lifecycle ownership.

The durable IDE-first policy and skill already exist. Re-evaluate only after C026.2 and C004; if those prerequisites make the existing owner sufficient, record reuse/no-change. Otherwise fill only confirmed documentation/test gaps, never ship a second IDE skill/router.

execution_policy.conditional_duplicate_rule: Before implementation, verify equivalent functionality. If sufficient, record local reuse/no-change and do not repeat implementation.
